facility_prologue.name: The Morning Collection
facility_prologue.description: Standard procedure for D-Class subjects. Security teams retrieve subjects for daily experimentation.

events.message: The distant rhythmic thud of combat boots is getting closer. 'D-902, get ready!' a voice barks from the intercom.
The dormitory door slams open. Three armed Guards stand there, rifles raised. 'D-902! Step forward immediately. You are scheduled for immediate testing in Sector 4.'

options.text: Stand up and follow the guards quietly.
options.log: D-902 complied without resistance. Proceeding with standard escort.

options.text: Refuse to move and glare at them.
options.log: D-902 attempted to resist. Compliance enforced via physical strike.

options.text: Quickly hide your found keycard and then stand up.
options.log: D-902 showed slight hesitation but complied. No search performed.

events.message: The overhead lights flicker violently. The hum of the facility's power core pitch-shifts into a low, ominous groan. 'Main power failing... backup generators... [REDACTED]'.
Total darkness. Then, the backup red emergency lights pulse. A roar echoes from the end of the hall. Your escorting guards freeze, looking at each other in terror. This is your chance.

options.text: Bolt into the darkness of a side hallway.
options.log: D-902 escaped into the maintenance shafts during the initial blackout.

options.text: Lunge for a panicked guard's sidearm.
options.log: D-902 attempted to disarm security. A struggle ensued.

options.text: Stay close to the guards and wait for orders.
options.log: D-902 remained stationary, showing absolute submission to authority.
